name: ui-tabs
description: Bootstrap nav with the tab plugin: tabs, pills, underline, list group, vertical, fill, card, fade, keyboard, persistence, data API.

descriptions.--bs-nav-link-gap: Space between icon and text of a tab.
descriptions.--bs-nav-link-hover-color: Text colour of a hovered tab.
descriptions.--bs-nav-link-active-color: Text colour of the active tab.
descriptions.--bs-nav-link-disabled-color: Text colour of a disabled tab.
descriptions.--bs-nav-link-transition-property: Properties animated on hover and activation.
descriptions.--bs-tab-pane-transition-property: Properties animated when a pane is shown (fade).
descriptions.--bs-nav-tabs-border-width: Tabs: width of the line under the tabs and of their borders.
descriptions.--bs-nav-tabs-border-color: Tabs: colour of the line under the tabs.
descriptions.--bs-nav-tabs-border-radius: Tabs: top corner radius of a tab.
descriptions.--bs-nav-tabs-link-hover-border-color: Tabs: border colour of a hovered tab.
descriptions.--bs-nav-tabs-link-active-color: Tabs: text colour of the active tab.
descriptions.--bs-nav-tabs-link-active-bg: Tabs: background of the active tab.
descriptions.--bs-nav-tabs-link-active-border-color: Tabs: border colours of the active tab (top, sides, bottom).
descriptions.--bs-nav-pills-border-radius: Pills: corner radius of the background.
descriptions.--bs-nav-pills-link-active-color: Pills: text colour of the active pill.
descriptions.--bs-nav-pills-link-active-bg: Pills: background of the active pill.
descriptions.--bs-nav-pills-link-border-radius: Pills: corner radius of a pill.
descriptions.--bs-nav-underline-link-active-color: Underline: text colour of the active tab.
